C1023.title: Classroom Candid Photo Turned Porn: High School Teacher Stripped by AI—South Korea’s Sexual Crime 2.0
C1023.summary: Since 2021, South Korea has seen a surge in cases where women’s photos are synthesized into nude or pornographic videos using AI deepfake technology. In 2023, high school teacher Kim was secretly photographed in a classroom, and her face was deepfaked onto nude images that spread widely.
